results.title: Compensation, Benefits & Payroll Operations Manager
results.description: At Printful, we achieve excellence because of our people. That’s why we’re looking for an innovative Compensation, Benefits & Payroll Manager to join us as we continue to grow. In this role, you will drive continuous improvement in our Benefits and Compensation processes to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and provide a seamless employee experience aligned with the People Operations strategy. You will be responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of compensation and benefits administration, payroll processing, and contributing to enhancements in business processes as well as providing Leadership to our Payroll & Benefits Administrator and HR Compliance/HRIS Specialist. We seek an experienced professional to lead Compensation and Benefits in the US. In this position, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of compensation and benefits administration, payroll processing, and contributing to enhancements in business processes and HR information technology (HRIS). Your role includes driving continuous improvement in payroll and benefits processes to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and provide a seamless employee experience aligned with the People Operations strategy. In this position, you will foster strong relationships across the organization and with vendors to embody and promote the company culture. You will provide guidance and supervision for the Payroll & Benefits Administrator and HR Compliance/HRIS Specialist. Effective communication with diverse personalities and adept conflict management skills are essential for success in this role. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: CompensationWork closely with the Rewards and Planning team to administer and optimize company compensation programs. This involves gathering market data, facilitating salary reviews, and offering strategic counsel to leaders regarding compensation strategies, including salary frameworks and incentive schemes. Fulfill additional responsibilities and projects as directed by the Rewards and Planning Director or Senior People Operations Manager in the North American region. BenefitsOversee employee benefits programs, and ensure their competitiveness and alignment with our workforce's unique needs. This includes managing renewals, open enrollment, and regulatory compliance. Handle relationships with brokers and third-party administrators for benefit plans.Maintain benefits and compensation summaries for new hires and recruitment, ensuring accuracy and compliance. Administer union health and pension benefits according to contractual agreements while staying updated on evolving payroll and benefits laws and regulations for ongoing compliance.Collaborating closely with People Operations to develop and implement personnel policies that adhere to multi-state labor laws and reflect our company culture, mission, and values.Actively engage with the HR leadership team to provide support, identify opportunities or risks, and advocate for the best interests of employees and the company as a whole. PayrollOversee end-to-end payroll processing for 800+ employees across multiple states and various pay requirements. We have three manufacturing facilities and employees across ten states.Supervise leave of absence procedures, guide People Operations HR Managers on disability options, and ensure accurate administration of FMLA, ADA, and other types of leave across all levels and facilities.Remain informed on evolving payroll laws and ensure company payroll adheres to regulations. ReportingManage the reporting and analytics of payroll, compensation, and benefits data, ensuring the development and communication of key performance indicators (KPIs) to relevant stakeholders. EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE and QUALIFICATIONSBachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field from a four-year college or university.3-5 years of payroll and benefits management experience, demonstrating expertise in multi-state laws.Comprehensive knowledge of Benefits, Compensation, HR, and payroll operations administration.HRIS proficiency, particularly with Workday, including payroll, benefits, and reporting.Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities with meticulous attention to detail.Experience with process improvement and automation preferred.Ability to multitask and work autonomously.Proficient in project management.Excellent interpersonal skills for productive collaboration across teams in a dynamic environment.Strong writing skills for creative and precise proofreading and editing.Upholds confidentiality with sensitive employee information. This position will report to both the Global Rewards and Planning Director and the Senior People Operations Manager in North America.

results.title: Human Resources Manager
results.description: Are you an experienced HR professional looking for an exciting opportunity? Look no further! Our client, a global company with a manufacturing facility in Columbus, Indiana, is seeking a dynamic HR Manager to join their team. About the Role:As the HR Manager, you will play a pivotal role in our organization's success. Reporting directly to the Global Head of HR and with a dotted line to the Plant Manager, you will lead a team and oversee HR operations for our 110 employees. This includes managing an HR Generalist and overseeing ADP Payroll processes. Key Responsibilities:- Implement HR policies and procedures in alignment with company objectives.- Provide guidance and support to management and employees on HR-related matters.- Lead recruitment efforts, including sourcing, interviewing, and onboarding new talent.- Manage performance evaluation processes and employee relations issues.- Oversee payroll administration and ensure accuracy and compliance.- Drive initiatives to enhance employee engagement and retention.- Collaborate with global HR teams to implement best practices and initiatives. Requirements:- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or related field.- Proven experience as an HR Manager or similar role, preferably in a manufacturing environment.- Strong knowledge of HR practices, employment law, and regulations.- Experience with ADP Payroll system preferred.- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.- SHRM or HRCI certification a plus. Perks and Benefits:- Competitive salary range: $100,000 to $125,000, plus a 10% bonus.- Opportunity to work with a global team in a dynamic environment.- Potential for flexible hybrid work arrangements (3 or 4 days in the office depending on plant needs).

results.title: Human Resources Supervisor (On-site)
results.description: Job Category: Human Resources Job Family: Plant HR Job Description: As a Human Resources Supervisor, you will be a key HR leader in our Carthage, Missouri manufacturing plant. As the HR Supervisor you will execute: recruitment and selection, employee relations, work life balance improvement projects, maximize partner morale, wage and benefit changes, safety improvements, training and development, policy administration, and regulatory compliance related to employment. The HR Supervisor will be part of a larger HR & Operations leadership team, who collaborate and support one another. This position is 100% on-site at the plant. Eligible partners will receive: Get not one, but TWO retirement benefits. When you join our employee-owned company, you’ll be part of our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) from day one. That means in addition to an 8% 401(k) match into the ESOP, Schreiber will contribute an extra amount – about 10% of your earnings – toward your retirement every year. That’s a company contribution of around 18% in retirement savings annually!Earn bonus pay. You’ll have an opportunity to earn incentive pay twice a year when we meet our company goals.Earn $ for focusing on your health. Get up to $1,200 for your health savings account each year, plus get reimbursed for fitness membership, equipment or classes.Pursue development that’s relevant to your role, career goals and the company. Plus, we offer tuition reimbursement if you want to further your education to grow in your role at Schreiber.Get access to medical, prescription drug, dental and vision benefits starting day one. This includes an onsite nurse and mental health counselor.Experience caring like you’ve never experienced it before. We have a program that’s completely organized by and for other partners who need extra help. It’s called Partners Helping Partners. We have hundreds of examples of partners organizing fundraisers to help out others going through a hard time. Sound like a company you’d like to be a part of? Click Apply. Need extra assistance with the application process? Contact recruiting@schreiberfoods.com or call 920-437-7601. For positions that require any amount of travel: Valid driver's license, auto insurance (at least state minimum- more might be required), acceptable driving record per Schreiber Foods discretion, and vehicle that will ensure applicant can meet the travel necessities of the position are required. Schreiber requires that an employee have authorization to work in the country in which the role is based. In the event, an applicant does not have current work authorization, Schreiber will determine, in its sole discretion, whether to sponsor an individual for work authorization. However, based on immigration requirements, not all roles are suitable for sponsorship. An Equal Opportunity Employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. results.title: Human Resources Manager
results.description: Human Resource ManagerWhat will you do as a Human Resource Manager?As a Human Resources Manager, you'll provide Human Resources support to all levels in the organization including benefits administration, payroll, time-off management, and employee relations. This position will work closely with managers on employee issues and engagement, as well as interpreting company policy and practices. Main Job Tasks and Responsibilities Maintain confidentiality on all levels of employee interactionProvide employee relations support to staff and managers while maintaining appropriate documentationAdministration of employee benefits including processing of paperwork, working with brokers and benefit providers, maintaining accuracy of billing, and assisting in resolving employee benefit questions/conflicts/problemsOrganize and conduct open enrollment benefit meetingsOrganize and participate in monthly Lunch & Learn Conduct new employee orientationCoordinate employee training and development Provide assistance with misc. projects, such as performance management, compliance reporting and record keepingReconcile timecards for payroll, troubleshoot and research payroll related questions/issues and provide solutions for employee questionsResponsible for recruitment efforts for all entry-level and non-supervisory positions including posting open positions, reviewing resumes, conducting initial phone screening, interviewing, and running background checks.Maintain and organize employment records including updating employment files and databases, preparing paperwork for processing new hires and terminations, verifying employment, processing change of status forms and creating HR database reportsAdminister and track FMLA leaveAssist the Office Manager in employee event planningOther duties as assigned Am I a Good Fit?It is important to be self-motivated, able to maintain confidentiality, and be able to recognize employee relation issues that are vital in any Human Resources role. We seek a candidate that will identify and utilize methods and tools to recruit qualified candidates to meet today's staffing challenges and needs. We have an HR department of one, so the ability to multitask and interact with all levels of employees while being perceived as approachable and a knowledgeable resource is key. From strategy and creative development, through plan implementation and execution, we provide every service to successfully execute direct marketing programs for our clients in the U.S. and Canada. Salary & Benefits Salary commensurate with education and experience.Day one comprehensive health, dental, vision and long-term disability Employer-matched 401KPTO and Holidays Casual Dress Policy

results.title: Human Resources Generalist
results.description: Company DescriptionThe Haseko Family of Companies has been developing Hawaii's most prized hotel, commercial and residential projects since 1973, including Ocean Pointe and the emerging Hoakalei Resort in Ewa Beach. Role DescriptionThis is a full-time on-site role located in Ewa Beach, HI for a Human Resources Generalist. results.title: Benefits Coordinator
results.description: SummaryThe Benefits Coordinator is responsible for employee benefits administration such as health, dental, life, vision,and pension plans. This position also administers the workers compensation, unemployment, and propertycasualty insurance coverages. Additionally, this position processes the absence leaves for vacation, FMLA,sick leave, and leave of absences. Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.● Coordinate daily operations of employee benefits.● Administer employee benefit plans, including enrollments, changes, and terminations.● Enrolls new employees in benefit plans and provides benefits orientation.● Process and maintain required information in payroll and insurance systems to ensure accurate recordkeepingand proper benefit and deduction amounts.● Audit and reconcile payroll deduction and benefits amounts for employee benefits.● Troubleshoot and resolve employee benefit issues and questions from current and potentialemployees.● Develop communication tools to enhance understanding of employee benefits packages.● Audit and submit payment for employee benefit premiums.● Invoice employees for insurance premiums not collected through payroll.● Complete and submit ACA reports.● Provides vendors appropriate documentation for life, pension, and disability benefits claims.● Processes leave of absence approvals and rejections.● Processes unemployment claims filed by former employees.● Participates in unemployment hearings.● Posts Summary Benefit Plan Descriptions for employees.● Administers District Leave program, including FMLA, General Leaves and IMRF Benefit ProtectedLeaves.● Processes time off allotments such as vacation, sick and personal time for all employees.● Maintains records for District Leave Program.● Submits and maintains workers’ compensation records.● Prepares annual OSHA report.● Process verification of employment forms for current and former employees.
